coverage.reason: States that open-end index and fully transparent active ETFs can rely on the rule and lists UIT ETFs under 'Need separate exemptive relief'.
Lists leveraged/inverse ETFs under the rule, notes the 2020 release removed their exclusion and rescinded their orders, and says they must comply with Rule 18f-4.

Covers non-transparent/semi-transparent active ETFs and ETF share classes needing separate orders, and the daily holdings disclosure condition. It omits master-feeder structures, so the bundle is incomplete.

rationale: There is no central error. UITs are correctly placed outside the rule, leveraged/inverse ETFs are not categorically excluded, and non-transparent ETFs and share classes are correctly said to need separate relief. The ancillary 18f-4 details (VaR limit, grandfathering, late-2025 staff letters) cannot be refuted from the supplied evidence, so they are not treated as falsehoods. The required-point total is 2.5 of 3 because master-feeder is missing from point 3, so not every required minimum is fully covered. The truncated ending ('My knowledge runs') does not remove any substantive content.
